segments.contextBefore: To avoid blocking an app’s main queue, CloudKit operations and their callbacks must run on a secondary queue, which can be an app-provided operation queue ([`OperationQueue`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/OperationQueue)), or a private operation queue that CloudKit manages.
segments.contextAfter: This means the system can access the cached data from different queues: the app’s main queue that reads the data and updates the app UI, and a secondary queue that runs CloudKit operations and updates the data.
